"Counting the Money: Preventing Fraud and Abuse in VA’s Bonus Payment Practices for VA Employees”

Date: 07.22.25

Time: 02:00 PM

Location: Cannon 360

On Tuesday, July 22, 2025, at 2:00 PM the Subcommittee on Oversight & Investigations will hold an Oversight Hearing titled, “Counting the Money: Preventing Fraud and Abuse in VA’s Bonus Payment Practices for VA Employees.”

Documents for the hearing can be found in the Committee Repository here.

VA's Workforce Dashboard archives mentioned during the hearing can be found here. 

WASHINGTON, D.C. OFFICE
550 Cannon House Office Building Washington, DC 20515
PHONE: 202.225.9756
